title: Your cache key is a specification
thesis: A cache key enumerates everything the render depends on, so getting it wrong is a correctness bug rather than a performance one.
reader_knowledge: Comfortable with HTTP caching and the idea of invalidation; no knowledge of this render pipeline.
reader_problem: They are about to add a cache in front of something expensive and will reach for the obvious key.
opening_direction: Open on the measured win, immediately qualified, so the reader knows the piece is not a victory lap.

argument_structure.heading: The win, and what it cost
argument_structure.purpose: Establish the numbers and the qualification in the same breath.
required_examples: The p99 figure with its measurement window stated

argument_structure.heading: Why a cache was viable at all
argument_structure.purpose: Determinism is the precondition; without it the article recommends a bug.

argument_structure.heading: The key that was missing two inputs
argument_structure.purpose: The concrete failure: locale and publish revision absent from the key.
required_examples: The three-line cache_key function as it originally stood

argument_structure.heading: What I would do differently
argument_structure.purpose: The author's own reading, clearly marked as opinion.

required_conclusion: A cache key is a specification of the render's inputs; write it as one and invalidation stops being a separate task.
platform_constraints: Personal blog: no house style, but code blocks must be short enough to read on a phone.
style_overrides: First person is allowed; the incident is the author's own.
excluded_material: The internal postmortem covering the deploy is not publishable.
reserved_material: The determinism argument is reserved for the follow-up article and should only be stated, not developed.

definition_of_done.description: Every stated number carries the conditions it was measured under.
The cache_key example appears verbatim as it stood before the fix.
Nothing from the internal postmortem appears in any form.
The opinion section is marked as the author's reading rather than a finding.
A closing line the reader could quote back.
